text: Yes - under the procedure, PIBA has discretion about whether they will give you the multiple-entry visa (called an intervisa). In your case, they are much more likely to give you one because you have applied according to the procedure (they are usually reluctant to give intervisas where a person has applied for a partner visa while in Israel as a tourist). They may also be more likely to give intervisas if you can give a specific reason about why you want one - e.g. planned trips. Usually they don't have any other conditions attached.
